items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: We had Bobby Burns, came in on the trombone section. For a while we had Lou McGarity in there. Bob Alexander. We had Stanley Webb in the sax section.

ctx.x: Danny Perry, yeah. And as you say, Bob Haggett on the bass. We had Bobby Burns, came in on the trombone section. For a while we had Lou McGarity in there. Bob Alexander. We had Stanley Webb in the sax section.
